textbookBox.concept: Terms: pole P, centre of curvature C, principal axis, principal focus F and focal length f. For a spherical mirror, f = R/2.

beats.en: Terms: pole P, centre of curvature C, principal axis, principal focus F and focal length f. For a spherical mirror, f = R/2.
beats.speakEn: Terms: pole P, centre of curvature C, principal axis, principal focus F and focal length f. For a spherical mirror, f  equals  R/2.

beats.en: A concave mirror forms real and inverted images, except when the object is between P and F, where the image is virtual, erect and enlarged.
